consumer: The find-item quest's possession gate evaluated by the dialogue/condition predicate set_has_items, asking 'does the character actor have item flashlight?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory, including nested contents the predicate would traverse)
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_items builds the u_has_items/npc_has_items lambda that returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, computing a yes/no the quest gate consumes
divergence: A flashlight nested inside a worn holster/container: the engine predicate has_amount over the actor returns true (the quest gate passes), but a re-derivation that only scans the top-level carried_items[] entries returns false, exposing the wrong answer
